title: EnvironmentNotice

protocolVersion.description: A wire protocol version: one integer, bumped only on a breaking change.

oneOf.description: The environment finished starting and accepts work: which version started.

fromVersion.description: The harness version that ran before the update.

toVersion.description: The harness version the environment was updated to.

oneOf.description: The environment now runs another harness version: from which, to which.

drainingSince.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

trigger.description: What started a drain: command (environment.drain from a client session), launcher (the launcher's drain query), signal (SIGTERM or SIGINT).

payload.description: A drain as it began: since when, and what started it.

oneOf.description: The environment refuses new runs and lets running ones finish before a restart: since when, and what started it.

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

change.description: What changed on an account: adopted, added, identity-set, status-changed, relabelled, removed, or identity-mismatch (a run's provider, or a status read, named a login other than the one the store holds, or one another account holds; the notice carries a warning).

warning.description: What a person should know, when something is wrong: a mismatched identity, a sign-in refused as a duplicate.

payload.description: account.updated: an account changed; a client refreshes what it caches of the accounts.

oneOf.description: An account changed: which, how, and a warning when something is wrong.

accountId.description: The account whose directory is being signed in.

state.description: Where a sign-in is: starting, awaiting-code (the verification URL is published), submitting (a code was written to the provider's CLI), or ended: done (the status read found the account signed in), failed, expired (ten minutes without a code, or a submission that never finished) or cancelled.

url.description: The verification URL a person opens to sign in, once the provider's CLI has printed it; null until then.

expiresAt.description: When the sign-in expires if it is still waiting: ten minutes after it started, or after the code was written.

posix.description: For sh, bash or zsh: the directory variable set on the command, the directory single-quoted.

powershell.description: For PowerShell: the directory variable set, then the executable called, each path single-quoted.

fallback.description: The exact command that signs the account's directory in from a terminal on the environment's machine, in POSIX and PowerShell renderings.

error.description: Why the sign-in failed, expired or was cancelled, when there is more to say; null otherwise.

payload.description: A sign-in of an account's directory: its state, the verification URL, when it expires, the fallback command, and why it ended when it did not succeed.

oneOf.description: The sign-in changed state: the sign-in as it is now, with the verification URL once it is awaiting a code.

provider.description: A provider's id, as the environment's adapter registry keys it: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (claude).

source.description: Which executable sign-ins run: bundled (the provider's binary the SDK ships, which runs use too) or managed-tool (the provider's CLI on the environment's PATH, when the bundled binary does not run a sign-in).

executable.description: The executable chosen, as it was found.

bundled.description: The bundled binary the choice was made against; null when this platform has none. A different one is probed again.

detail.description: Why the bundled binary was passed over, when it was.

payload.description: signin.executable-chosen: which executable the environment's sign-ins for a provider run, chosen once and recorded.

oneOf.description: The environment chose the executable its sign-ins for a provider run: the bundled binary, or the managed tool when the bundled one does not run a sign-in.

sessionId.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

kind.description: What a prompt asks: permission (a tool call the mode does not allow without asking), denylist (a call that touches the denylist), question (the model asks its user), or plan (a plan to approve, with the mode to continue in).

title.description: The session's title as the list shows it, for a notification.

oneOf.description: A run is parked on a prompt, waiting for a person: which session, run and prompt, the session's title and what is asked.

sessionId.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

decision.description: Whether the call may go ahead: allow, or deny.

anyOf.description: A client session's id, as hello names it and the access methods list and revoke it.

auto.description: What answered a prompt when no person did: unattended (nobody is present for the run), bypass (a residual prompt in bypassPermissions), ttl (it waited past its TTL), run_ended (its run ended on its own first), reviewer (a provider's automatic reviewer), cancelled (the provider cancelled the request, its tool call moot, while the run went on).

decidedBy.description: Who answered a prompt: the id of the client session a person answered from, or {auto} naming the rule.

oneOf.description: A parked prompt was answered, by a person or a rule: which one, the decision, and who made it.

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

provider.description: A provider's id, as the environment's adapter registry keys it: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (claude).

email.description: The login's email, as the provider's status reports it.

organisation.description: The organisation the login belongs to, when the provider reports one.

anyOf.description: Who an account signed in as: the provider, the email and the organisation when present; one account per identity per environment.

identity.description: Who the account is signed in as, the gauge a client pools the reading into; null when not known.

payload.description: usage.updated: an account's plan-usage reading changed (its windows, a verdict a run reported, its identity or why it is unavailable); a client refreshes what it caches of accounts.usage and asks accounts.handoff.recommend again.

oneOf.description: An account's plan-usage reading changed: which account, and the identity whose gauge it is.

description: An event on the environment stream, as environment.subscribe delivers it: its type and payload, read from the event's envelope.
